channel.comment: IMPORTANT: this pipeline uploads with the SAME YT_TOKEN_JSON as the Shorts pipeline, i.e. onto the SAME YouTube channel (@KrishnaUniverse). Descriptions used to welcome viewers to 'Krishna Universe', a brand that does not exist on that channel. The name is aligned here so the audience, the branding and YouTube's topic model all agree. If these long-form stories are ever moved to their own channel, change this back and give that channel its own token.
channel.name: Sweet Soul Stories
channel.cta: Subscribe for a brand-new story every single day!
channel.cta_pool_note: The 30 rotating sign-offs now live in modules/pools.py (CTA_CANDIDATES) and are drawn without replacement via modules/history.py. Adding a 'cta_pool' array here would OVERRIDE that larger pool, so leave it out unless you deliberately want a shorter list.

seo.comment: Consumed by modules/seo.py. Chapters need >=3 entries, must start at 0:00, and each must be >=10s or YouTube ignores the whole block.

video.comment_duration: Retargeted to 3-5 minutes. NOTE: the composer never cuts the video to max_duration_seconds - it always matches the voiceover length - so length is actually controlled by story.target_words below. These bounds only decide when a warning is logged.

story.comment: THIS is what controls video length. The storyteller voice runs ~145 words/minute at the configured rate, so 420-700 words = 3-5 minutes. A story over max_words is rejected and the next model is asked; if all of them overshoot, the shortest is trimmed at a sentence boundary with the moral re-appended.

palette.comment: Calm dark-blue storytime backdrop used only when no footage is available

ai_images.style: soft warm childrens storybook illustration, gentle cartoon style, wholesome, cinematic lighting, no text, no words, no letters

youtube.hashtags_note: FALLBACK ONLY. Per-episode rotating hashtags now come from modules/seo.py.
youtube.default_tags_note: FALLBACK ONLY. modules/seo.py builds the per-episode tag set within YouTube's 500-char budget.
